references.text: The Lord's mercy and grace, patience and great compassion.
And since they had nothing to pay with, he forgave them both. Which of them will love him most?
And forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

Then the lord called him to himself and said to him: You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me. Should not you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?
